description: Source file implementing the CubicBytes congestion control algorithm for QUIC, including functions for handling packet loss, acknowledgments, and congestion window calculations.

classes.name: CubicBytes
classes.description: Class implementing the Cubic congestion control algorithm for QUIC, managing congestion window adjustments based on network conditions.

methods.name: CubicBytes
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CubicBytes object with a clock reference.

methods.name: SetNumConnections
methods.description: Sets the number of active connections for the cubic algorithm.

methods.name: Alpha
methods.description: Calculates the alpha parameter for congestion window increase, based on the number of connections and beta.

methods.name: Beta
methods.description: Calculates the backoff factor after packet loss for N-connection emulation.

methods.name: BetaLastMax
methods.description: Calculates the additional backoff factor after loss, emulating TCP-Reno behavior.

methods.name: ResetCubicState
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the congestion control to initial conditions.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Handles periods when the sender is application-limited, resetting the epoch.

methods.name: CongestionWindowAfterPacketLoss
methods.description: Calculates the new congestion window after packet loss event.

methods.name: CongestionWindowAfterAck
methods.description: Calculates the congestion window after receiving ACKs, updating based on cubic and TCP estimations.
